final_rationale: The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence. The response mainly narrows and caveats the certification theory, which is a reinterpretation of the same record rather than new proof. Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, and public guidance supports disclosure and monitoring practices, but neither satisfies the policy predicate for certification without material caveats. Because the initial concerns were not closed by new admissible evidence, the verdict remains suspicious rather than moving to compliant_with_caveats.
